generationInputs.prompt: A logo design featuring text and geometric shapes on a white background. The central element is a hexagonal shape in a muted teal or sage green color. Below the line, the number "360" is written in the same dark gray sans-serif font as "MAC," also horizontally centered. The entire graphic, including the text and the hexagon, is enclosed within two concentric circles in the same muted teal/sage green color. The outer circle is slightly thicker than the inner circle. Below the main circular design, centered horizontally, are the words "GESTIÓN ADMINISTRATIVA" in the same dark gray sans-serif font, stacked in two lines. "GESTIÓN" is on the top line, and "ADMINISTRATIVA" is on the bottom line. The overall aesthetic is clean, corporate, and modern, using a limited color palette of white, dark gray, and muted teal/sage green.
